formats.analysis: Markdown file with 'acme-ads-analysis.md' or similar name in current directory

content_requirements: Report must state total number of extracted ads as 3
Report must mention main messaging themes including 'tool sprawl', 'meeting overload', or 'collaboration'
Report must mention call-to-action phrases such as 'Try now', 'Get started', or 'Learn more'
Report includes recommendations on what messaging is working
